name: micode
description: A local-first coding-agent toolkit for safely exploring, editing, testing, and managing projects on a local computer and remote VPS over SSH.

interface.longDescription: Work with project files, search code, run commands, inspect tests, and use Git on configured local workspaces. A local executor can also reach configured VPS workspaces over SSH. Destructive actions and production operations require explicit user approval.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MiCode to inspect and work on my selected local or VPS project. Start by checking the project structure and Git status, explain your plan, and ask before destructive or production-impacting actions.
